title: Juicy Flaky Vietnamese Pork Banh Mi
description: A cultured and flaky Vietnamese dish featuring pork, pickled vegetables, and a crispy baguette, made with fast action yeast and pasta water emulsion, and cooked in a tagine pot.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine pork shoulder, fast action yeast, and pasta water, and mix until a sticky dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a tagine pot, cover with a lid, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Place the tagine pot in the oven and bake for 20 minutes.
While the pork is baking, prepare the pickled vegetables by slicing them into thin strips.
Assemble the banh mi by spreading mayonnaise on the crispy baguette, then adding the baked pork, pickled vegetables, cucumber, and cilantro.
Drizzle sriracha on top of the banh mi and serve immediately.
Let the banh mi cool for a few minutes before serving.
